summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Vehicle HMI Dashboard for 1989 Honda Accord. All requested features working perfectly including custom PNG gauge assets, VTEC glow, orangish-red shift lights, Android Auto mock panel, and Orbitron font implementation.
passed_tests: Dashboard loads with custom gauge PNG assets (RPM and Speed gauges)
RPM gauge shows digital readout in Orbitron font (verified: 'Orbitron, sans-serif')
Shift lights are orangish-red color with progressive lighting based on RPM
VTEC glow functionality implemented (activates when RPM > 3000)
Gear indicator shows URUS style with prev/current/next gear display
PS3 breathing background animation (normal gray, switches to red at 85+ mph)
Warning lights spread out at bottom (LOW FUEL, SERVICE, etc.)
Android Auto button appears and opens panel when clicked
Android Auto panel shows maps, music, phone, home views with navigation
Android Auto mock panel displays navigation info, time, and ETA
Settings panel opens correctly with theme selection
Settings panel includes brightness control and warning sounds toggle
Orbitron font applied to speed, gear, and RPM displays
Real-time data updates with needle animations
Turn signals functionality with green indicators
No console errors or JavaScript issues detected
